question: How does consciousness manifest beings without division?
premises: Consciousness opens forth by its own forceful surge.
It makes the portions of beings shine.
It shines them without division and as non-different from itself.
inference: Self-manifesting consciousness reveals all beings as undivided and identical with itself.
plain_english: Thus, by the force of its own surge, consciousness opens forth by itself and, without division, makes the portions of beings shine as non-different from its own self.
